title: Topic 19: Health & Body - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Say what hurts, name body parts, manage a pharmacy visit

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Medicine label format
MEDICINE - FOR HEADACHE
Take ONE with water, in the morning.
Take ONE at night.
DON'T take three in one day!
Not for children under twelve.
Sick for three days? Go to the doctor!
Questions? Ask us at PHARMACY BELA - next to the
supermarket, open every day, eight to eight.

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Duna: Vito?! You are not at school today. Are you OK?
Vito: I am sick, Duna. I have a headache, and my legs
      are very tired.
Duna: Oh no! Do you have medicine at home?
Vito: Yes. My mother is at the pharmacy now - more
      medicine for tonight.
Duna: Good. Now sleep! And DON'T watch films all day!
Vito: Ha!... OK. One film. ONE!

readingQuestions.question: How does a person take this medicine?
options: One in the morning, one at night, with water
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: One in the morning, one at night, with water

readingQuestions.question: You take the medicine, but you are sick for three days. What is the right thing to do?
Why does Duna write to Vito?
options: He is not at school, and she asks how he is
She wants to watch a film
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: He is not at school, and she asks how he is

readingQuestions.question: Duna says: DON'T watch films all day! What does this tell us about Vito?
options: Films are his big hobby - he watches a lot
He has no TV at home
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: Films are his big hobby - he watches a lot
